domains.finding: Node 24 support is restricted to 24.16.0+; the alternate supported line starts at 26.1.0.
domains.agentOsDecision: Require 24.16.0+ on the Node 24 line and reject Node 24.0 through 24.15, Node 25, and Node 26.0.

domains.finding: Successful config.patch responses expose authoritative changedPaths after validation and secret restoration; a no-op returns changedPaths [].
domains.agentOsDecision: Carry bounded path-only changedPaths through the typed mutation result and use effective paths for restart decisions, with legacy fallback when absent.

domains.finding: The 9.3 descriptor keeps users.self as a read operation (operator.read); the prior AgentOS mirror incorrectly required operator.write.
domains.agentOsDecision: Align the static AgentOS scope contract and collaboration certification with the exact 9.3 descriptor; users.self remains discovery-only and does not authorize profile mutation.

domains.finding: State schema advances 15 to 16 while agent schema remains 19. The Skill Workshop ownership migration is Doctor/runtime-owned and moves the collection to persistent agent ownership.
domains.agentOsDecision: Do not implement a parallel Workshop store. Gate promotion on a real disposable 9.2 state migration and project native skill ownership.

domains.finding: The native updater adds candidate rehearsal, bounded repair, activation and service/version/build/plugin/channel/HTTP readiness verification, rollback/recovery, durable continuity, and abandoned-update recovery.
domains.agentOsDecision: Keep OpenClaw update.status/update.run/update.runs.* authoritative; AgentOS only applies policy, presents bounded phases, reconnects, and independently verifies.

domains.finding: Provider account add/remove and priority/order, fallback selection, OAuth recovery, and local provider/model discovery are native 9.3 surfaces.
domains.agentOsDecision: Retain AgentOS projections and onboarding policy, but do not duplicate native provider/account state or add unrelated UI.

domains.finding: Spawned sessions are persistent and recursive delegation is bounded by native depth/concurrency/session ownership rules.
domains.agentOsDecision: Preserve native parent/child/session visibility and keep AgentOS authorization and presentation as a projection.

domains.finding: Supported create-capable CLI agents may appear in the new-session catalog when gateway.cliAgents.enabled is active by default.
domains.agentOsDecision: Parse and project CLI-agent entries distinctly from provider models; do not force the native setting off.

domains.finding: Several retired SDK contracts are removed or relocated. The AgentOS browser-policy plugin continues to use openclaw/plugin-sdk/plugin-entry.
domains.agentOsDecision: Repository-wide retired-usage audit must remain zero; no compatibility shim is added for unused APIs.

domains.finding: Gateway protocol remains v4; the existing typed Gateway-first transport remains the native path.
domains.agentOsDecision: No transport rewrite, REST proxy, CLI substitution, or parallel AgentOS runtime state.

domains.finding: New security-sensitive transcript-link capability is not required for compatibility and is not automatically surfaced.
domains.agentOsDecision: Keep explicit sessions.visibility=tree, agentToAgent.enabled=false, and agentToAgent.allow=[] for AgentOS-managed Gateways; preserve explicit operator values and do not mutate externally owned config.
